## Procedure

1. Keep back flat and shoulder blades pulled together
2. Lower into a quarter squat position by pushing hips back, flexing knees, letting the torso come forward, and transfer the weight onto the heels (-24)
3. Explosively extend hips and knees to accelerate the bar upward
4. Drive the bar upward by extending arms completely, pressing it overhead
5. At the top of the lift, the bar should be slightly behind the ears with elbows completely extended and in line with the shoulders and hips (-25)
6. As the bar is caught overhead, flex hips backward, keep knees behind toes, and sit into a quarter squat position
7. Extend hips and knees to stand erect
8. Lower the bar to the start position in a controlled manner
